title: Ghost Hunt
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-schooler Mai Taniyama ends up assisting Kazuya Shibuya, the 17-year-old head of Shibuya Psychic Research, after a mishap during an investigation of a supposedly cursed school building (Del Rey and MangaUpdates blurbs). They are joined by a former Buddhist monk, a self-proclaimed Shinto priestess, a famous medium and a Catholic priest as they investigate hauntings. Based on Fuyumi Ono's novels.
life_message: Careful investigation, courage and teamwork can face the unknown and bring hidden suffering to light.

content.note: Murders, corpses, accidents caused by hauntings (MangaUpdates, Del Rey blurb); Gore and Body Horror spoiler tags (AniList).
Horror genre; dark, foreboding panels and 'blood-scented visions' (ANN); Dark Ambience, Curses (MangaUpdates).
Students try to summon spirits with ghost stories (Del Rey blurb).

dominant: Paranormal investigation; science-and-ritual teamwork; spirits as real

frames.aligns: A Catholic priest, John Brown, is part of the team; spirits' suffering taken seriously.
frames.concerns: Mediumship and summoning spirits treated as normal tools (CCC 2116).
Medium and exorcists of several religions treated as equal.
Spirit contact, mediums and summoning ghosts.
Occult practice and mediumship shown approvingly.
Spirit contact, curses and mixed exorcism traditions.

frames.aligns: Methodical inquiry (ANN notes measuring and research).
Gothic mystery in a long literary tradition.

frames.concerns: Mediums and spirit-summoning resemble forbidden practices.

frames.aligns: Spirits and rites part of the worldview.
Former monk Takigawa; easing restless spirits.

frames.concerns: Psychic powers and ghosts presented as real.

Harmony of science and spirit hinted at.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Disputes settled by investigation, not personal honor.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Measuring and research over 'wards and chants' (ANN).

folkways.japan: Mixes Japanese folk belief, Shinto priestesses and Buddhist rites with modern parapsychology, reflecting Japan's layered religious practice.

delivery.evidence: ANN calls the storytelling dry and methodical; no moralizing noted.
delivery.note: Practitioners of several religions work side by side; ANN calls them stereotyped roles rather than voices for ideas.

winners_losers: The investigators and endangered clients are the sympathetic side; vengeful spirits and the crimes behind them are the threat.
